proof.text: Apply exteriorSheaf_map_exists to S.g and degree r₃. Tensor the resulting morphism with the identity of exteriorPower S.X₁ r₁ to form q. tensorHom_app_tmulSection and the pure-wedge formula give the required formula for q on every open.
Apply exteriorSheaf_wedgeMap_exists to S.f, r₁, r₃ and r₂ = r₁ + r₃, giving the pre-quotient wedge map psi with its concatenation formula.
Apply determinant_wedge_quotient_factor to q and psi and their generator formulas. Obtain phi with q followed by phi equal to psi.

Evaluate this factorization on the tensor of the wedge of a and the wedge of c over U. Rewrite using the formulas for q and psi, and use function extensionality on the lift equations to replace S.g(c) by b. This gives the required formula for phi.

lean.statement:
theorem determinant_wedgeMorphism_local_data_at {X : Scheme.{v}}
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact) (r₁ r₂ r₃ : ℕ) (hr : r₂ = r₁ + r₃)
    [S.X₁.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r₁] (U : X.Opens) :
    ∃ φU : exteriorPower S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorPower S.X₃ r₃ ⟶
      exteriorPower S.X₂ r₂,
      ∀ (a : Fin r₁ → S.X₁.val.obj (op U))
        (b : Fin r₃ → S.X₃.val.obj (op U)) (c : Fin r₃ → S.X₂.val.obj (op U)),
        (∀ i, S.g.val.app (op U) (c i) = b i) →
        φU.val.app (op U)
          (tmulSection (wedge (M := S.X₁) (r := r₁) (U := U) a)
            (wedge (M := S.X₃) (r := r₃) (U := U) b)) =
          wedge (M := S.X₂) (r := r₂) (U := U)
            (fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun j ↦ S.f.val.app (op U) (a j)) c (Fin.cast hr i))
